title: Auto-discovery walker for projects
description: Port singularity's --generate-config-from-dir: recursive walk from a configurable root (default ~/code), stop at .git, group siblings sharing a parent dir as suggested projects. Returns ProjectDef[] without writing. New module electron/project-discovery.ts. Configurable maxDepth and ignore list. Acceptance: discovers existing multi-repo layouts; respects .gitignore-style excludes; runs <2s on ~/code with 50 repos.

title: Project settings dialog
description: Per-project settings: displayName, color, icon, default model/thinking/approval. Persists via project update IPC. Tabs: General, Repos, Diff viewer (delegated to Phase C), Advanced. Acceptance: changes survive restart; defaults applied to new sessions in that project.

title: Project CRUD IPC + preload API
description: IPC channels projects:list/get/create/update/delete/pin/touch; preload api.* additions. Validates inputs; never writes secrets. Acceptance: round-trip create→update→delete via preload API; pin and lastOpenedAt update reflected in catalog.

title: App store: add + create project workspace
description: addProjectWorkspace in app-store-workspace.ts: validates root path, calls syncWorkspace, stores projectKey+repoPaths. IPC handler workspaces:addProject + preload api.addProjectWorkspace. Extend startThread/createWorktree: when environment===worktree AND workspace has repoPaths, use MultiRepoWorktreeManager instead of GitWorktreeManager. Single-repo flow unaffected. Acceptance: project workspace in sidebar, worktree creation makes N linked git worktrees.

title: Built-in image + markdown diff viewers
description: Image viewer: before/after with slider; auto-selected for raster + svg. Markdown viewer: rendered preview diff for *.md. Both register via DiffViewer interface. Acceptance: PNG change shows visual diff; README change shows rendered preview side-by-side.

title: Branch-compare UI (project-level)
description: New project-level panel powered by git-cross-branch source (pi-gui-c2c). Pick feature branch and base branch; per-repo ahead/behind + diff using chosen viewer. Acceptance: matches singularity /api/project/branch/compare semantics.

title: Per-project diff viewer config + persistence
description: Settings dialog Diff viewer tab: default renderer, per-extension overrides, preview pane. Persists on ProjectRecord.diffViewer. Renderer resolution priority: user override → project config → built-in default. Acceptance: setting per .md to markdown viewer survives restart and applies in diff panel.

title: UI: Multi-repo indicators in sidebar
description: Project workspaces in sidebar.tsx get repo-stack icon/badge + N repos count. Worktree entries under project show multi-repo tag. No layout changes for single-repo. Reuse icons.tsx patterns, no new deps. Acceptance: project workspace visually distinct from single-repo at a glance.

title: Spike: external diff tool adapter (delta/difftastic)
description: Time-boxed 1-day spike. External adapter pipes unified diff to a configured binary; renders ANSI/HTML in sandboxed pane. Allow-list binary paths; arg template parsed (no shell=true). Disabled by default. If sandboxing isn't crisp by EOD, write findings and close. Acceptance: working delta render OR documented blockers + close.

title: MultiRepoWorktreeManager
description: New class electron/multi-repo-worktree-manager.ts. createWorktreeSet(project, branchName) creates worktrees at ~/.worktrees/{project}/{branch}/{repo}/ concurrently, rolls back on partial failure, returns {rootPath, paths}. removeWorktreeSet gracefully handles missing. sanitizeBranchForPath helper. Reuses GitWorktreeManager per repo. Acceptance: parallel creation, clean rollback on error.

title: Multi-window: Open Project in New Window
description: Action on project row + Cmd+Enter in switcher. Each BrowserWindow owns one project's renderer state; main process is single writer of catalogs.json. Window position persisted per-project. Acceptance: two windows show different projects with independent session state; closing one does not corrupt the other's catalog.

title: DiffSource strategy interface; refactor app-store-diff
description: Introduce DiffSource {id, list(workspace), read(workspace, file)}. Move current logic into git-single source. app-store-diff.ts becomes coordinator. Acceptance: existing single-repo diff path unchanged; unit-testable source contract.

title: DiffSource: git-cross-branch
description: New diff source strategy that, given a project + feature branch + base branch, returns per-repo unified diffs and ahead/behind counts. No UI in this task (consumed later by branch-compare panel). New module electron/diff-sources/git-cross-branch.ts. Handles missing branch per repo gracefully. Acceptance: pure-data API; covered by unit tests with a fixture multi-repo project.

title: Epic: Project layer & Codex-style switcher
description: Layer a first-class Project concept on top of existing workspaces: ProjectRecord catalog, CRUD, sidebar restructure (pinned + recents + projects-with-workspaces), Cmd+K quick-switcher, per-project settings (color, icon, defaults), multi-window support, workspace-scoped UI state. Single-repo workspaces stay working via an Unfiled bucket. See plans/project-workspaces/plan.md (Phase B).

title: Epic: Multi-repo worktree support
description: Add multi-repo project support to pi-gui desktop. A project is a named set of repos (root + subrepos, as defined in ~/.config/singularity/projects.json). When creating a worktree for a project workspace, all repos get a linked git worktree at ~/.worktrees/{project}/{branch}/{repo}/. Multiple agents can run per worktree (already supported via multiple sessions). This epic covers the full vertical slice from config reading to UX.

title: ProjectRecord schema + projects.json catalog + singularity import
description: New userData/projects.json (v1) via JsonCatalogStore. ProjectRecord {id, key, displayName, color?, icon?, repos[], contextFiles[], diffViewer?, defaults?, pinned, lastOpenedAt?, tags[], source}. On first run, import ~/.config/singularity/projects.json as source=singularity (idempotent on key). Acceptance: catalog persists, migration is idempotent, missing singularity file is non-fatal.

title: UI: Add project workspace modal
description: New src/add-project-modal.tsx. Triggered from sidebar as Add project option. Calls api.listProjects() on mount. Shows projects: name + repo count. On select calls api.addProjectWorkspace(projectKey). Loading/error states. If projects.json missing: helpful message. Acceptance: user can add project workspace in under 3 clicks.

title: Session context injection + worktree progress UI
description: 1) Session context: when starting session in project worktree, inject subrepo paths as context (system prompt or context_files). Format: This is a multi-repo project. Sub-repo worktree paths: - pbd-api: path. Must not affect single-repo sessions. 2) Progress UI: spinner or inline indicator during multi-repo worktree creation showing Creating worktrees for N repos. On error show which repos failed. Acceptance: agent sees subrepo paths in context; user sees feedback within 500ms of creating worktrees.

title: DiffViewer interface + registry; refactor InlineDiff
description: Create packages/diff-viewers or src/diff-viewers/ with DiffViewer interface {id, displayName, capabilities, Component}. Registry is in-process (no dynamic user-code loading). Refactor existing InlineDiff to register as id=inline. No behavior change for users. Acceptance: types compile, current diff UI still works, registry exposes inline viewer.

title: Desktop state types for multi-repo
description: Extend TS types: WorkspaceKind add project. WorkspaceRecord add optional projectKey and repoPaths. New types ProjectConfig/ProjectDef/RepoDef. CreateProjectWorkspaceInput and CreateProjectWorktreeInput types. Acceptance: types compile, no behavior change to existing single-repo flow.

title: Built-in side-by-side diff viewer
description: Two-pane scroll-synced viewer with syntax highlighting (reuse existing highlight pipeline). Selectable per project. Acceptance: handles 5000-line file at 60fps scroll; light + dark themes.

title: Sidebar restructure: pinned + recents + projects
description: Reshape sidebar.tsx: top section Pinned (max 5), then Recent (max 8 by lastOpenedAt), then All Projects expanding to their workspaces (primary + worktrees rolled up under chevron). Existing standalone workspaces appear under Unfiled. Ship behind a feature flag for one release. Acceptance: no regressions for users without projects; project users see grouped view.

title: Workspace-scoped UI state
description: Persist last-active session, scroll position, last-selected diff file per workspace in ui-state.json. Restore on workspace switch. Acceptance: switching between workspaces preserves context without flicker.

title: DiffSource: git-multi for project workspaces
description: Parallel git status across all project repoPaths; merged file list with repo: prefix in path. Stable sort by repo then path. Acceptance: project workspace diff panel shows aggregated file list grouped per repo; per-file diff resolves correctly.

title: Cmd+K quick-switcher
description: Global Cmd/Ctrl+K opens fuzzy switcher over projects, workspaces (incl worktrees), and recent sessions. Enter switches; Cmd+Enter opens new window (depends on multi-window). Acceptance: switcher opens <50ms, fuzzy match across 200 entries, keyboard-only navigation.

title: Epic: Pluggable per-project diff viewers
description: Make diff rendering pluggable per project and per file type. Introduce DiffViewer (renderer) and DiffSource (data) interfaces; refactor current InlineDiff + app-store-diff.ts to fit. Built-in viewers: inline, side-by-side, image, markdown. Built-in sources: git-single (existing), git-multi (project workspaces), git-cross-branch. Per-project config UI. Optional external viewer adapter as spike. See plans/project-workspaces/plan.md (Phase C).

title: Project config reader
description: Read ~/.config/singularity/projects.json and expose via IPC. New module electron/project-config.ts. Reads ProjectConfig {projects: {[key]: {name, repos: [{name, path, default_branch}]}}}. Expands ~ in paths. Falls back gracefully when file missing. IPC channel projects:list. Preload api.listProjects(). Acceptance: listProjects() returns parsed config; missing file returns empty projects map.
